title: DmaxBs Mics And Cams
description: This is a resource pack that "adds" a Mic, a Cam and a Eurovision Trophy! (Based on the Eurovision Song Contest)
body:
# **1.0 PLANNED LATE 2026 (kinda lost intrest again but wanting to release around that time)** 


Hello there!
I have made a resource pack containing a mic, a cam and a eurovision based trophy.

The mics original item is a stick, the camera is a wooden sword and the trophy is a brown stained glass pane.

Notice!
This pack is only in alpha stage and im planning for the full release to be 10 times better than this alpha.

Somthing to say?
Just discord me :D
dc name: DmaxB
